openingPlayback.measurement: BT.709 luma of decoded, area-averaged frames with 16 by 10 regional bins. The home view includes the quiet interval, the first gravitational tide, freight capture and the impact.

matchedMineCyanArea.definition: Percentage of pixels with G > 60, G > 1.25 R and B > 1.10 R. Ordinary work lamps contribute to both versions.

shiftPlayback.method: Native WebGL drawing buffer from fixed home cameras. Five 1/60 s physics updates separate neighbouring frames. The video is sampled on [38,62) and presented through 62.000 s.

independentFixedStepMotionCheck.explanation: Same production physics modules, height raster and layout metadata, without rendering. The separate live capture timeline and decoded foreground pixels appear per orientation.

guidedPlayback.testEnvironment: Local Chromium with WebGL disabled, real HTML video elements, actual versioned production media, 1× continuous playback
guidedPlayback.handoffSampling: Canvas-composited visible DOM layers at 80×50 with 16×10 luminance blocks. A frame is black when mean RGB-weighted luminance is below 0.025 on a 0..1 scale.
